quests.name: Delivery to Silverpine Forest
objectives: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

quests.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
objectives: Deliver Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

quests.name: Ride to the Undercity
objectives: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from Karos Razok, then deliver Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham.

quests.name: Michael Garrett
objectives: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

quests.name: Return to Podrig
objectives: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig.

quests.name: Lost Deathstalkers
objectives: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick (Ivar Patch).

quests.name: Wild Hearts
objectives: Collect 6 Discolored Worg Hearts (Worg, Mottled Worg, Bloodsnout Worg, Gorefang) and turn them in to Renferrel.

quests.name: Return to Quinn
objectives: Bring Minor Quinn's Potion to Quinn Yorick at Ivar Patch.

quests.name: Wild Eyes
objectives: Collect 3 Murloc Eyes and give them to Apothecary Renferrel.

quests.name: Return to Quinn (Again)
objectives: Give Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at Ivar Patch.

quests.name: Ivar the Foul
objectives: Kill Ivar the Foul and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick.

quests.name: Escorting Erland
objectives: Escort Erland through the wolves to Rane Yorick.

quests.name: The Deathstalkers' Report
objectives: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec.

quests.name: Speak with Renferrel
objectives: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Zinge's Delivery
objectives: Deliver Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
objectives: Kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps (npc 1769).

quests.name: Arugal's Folly (1)
objectives: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal (Dusty Spellbooks ~52.8, 28.6) for Dalar Dawnweaver.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly (2)
objectives: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly (3)
objectives: Kill Grimson the Pale (cave ~58.6, 44.9) and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly (4, Elite)
objectives: Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles (item 3218) to Dalar Dawnweaver. Reward choice: Logsplitter, Bonegrinding Pestle or Cinder Wand.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly (5)
objectives: Collect 6 Worgen Bits dropped by Moonrage Bloodhowler (~53, 64) and bring them to Dalar Dawnweaver. Reward: Foulfur Gloves.

quests.name: Stop the Spread
objectives: Slay Haggard Refugees and Sickly Refugees (~46, 85). Counts unclear: description says 5 each, tracker shows 1 each.

quests.name: A Recipe For Death (1)
objectives: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 Skittering Blood and deliver them to Faranell in the Undercity.

quests.name: A Recipe For Death (2, Elite)
objectives: Retrieve Berard's Journal from Pyrewood Village (~42.9, 73.4) and take it to Renferrel.

quests.name: A Recipe For Death (3)
objectives: Collect 6 Lake Skulker Moss, 6 Lake Creeper Moss and 1 Hardened Tumor and deliver them to Faranell.

quests.name: The Dead Fields
objectives: Kill Dead Fields gnolls until Nightlash appears, kill her and bring the Essence of Nightlash back.

quests.name: The Decrepit Ferry
objectives: Go to the old ferry and find out why the Scourge is there.

quests.name: Rot Hide Clues
objectives: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec.

quests.name: The Engraved Ring
objectives: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

quests.name: Raleigh and the Undercity
objectives: Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh Andrean.

quests.name: A Husband's Revenge
objectives: Kill Valdred Moray (Silverpine ~44.6, 84.7) and return his hands to Raleigh Andrean.

quests.name: Rot Hide Ichor
objectives: Collect 8 Rot Hide Ichor and bring them to Renferrel.

quests.name: Rot Hide Origins
objectives: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: Thule Ravenclaw
objectives: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel.

quests.name: Report to Hadrec
objectives: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Resting in Pieces
objectives: Collect A Talking Head (Rot Hide mobs) and bring Alaric's Head to his grave.

quests.name: The Hidden Niche
objectives: Take Alaric's Remains to the hidden alcove.

quests.name: Wand to Bethor
objectives: Bring the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity Magic Quarter.

quests.name: Border Crossings
objectives: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates (Pyrewood Village area).

quests.name: Maps and Runes
objectives: Take the Rune-inscribed Pendant to Shadow Priest Allister.

quests.name: Dalar's Analysis
objectives: Deliver the Rune-inscribed Pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver.

quests.name: Dalaran's Intentions
objectives: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister.

quests.name: Ambermill Investigations
objectives: Collect 8 Dalaran Pendants (Ambermill, ~63, 64) and deliver them to Allister.

quests.name: Watching the Roads
objectives: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards (npc 1889) and 8 Dalaran Watchers (npc 1888) around Ambermill. Reward: Roadwatcher's Confidence (neck).

quests.name: The Weaver
objectives: Kill Archmage Ataeric (~63.4, 64.3) and bring Ataeric's Staff to Allister.

quests.name: Pyrewood Ambush (Elite)
objectives: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.

quests.name: Beren's Peril
objectives: Locate Beren's Peril, slay 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, return to Allister.

quests.name: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills
objectives: Deliver Renferrel's Findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, Hillsbrad Foothills.

notes: uiMapID NOT confirmed. Wowhead Forever pages do not expose it. 1421 is the Classic Era uiMapID and is kept as an assumption (a senseos.gg map image path also uses 1421). Retail (8.0+) uses 21 for Silverpine Forest, 18 Tirisfal Glades, 90 Undercity, 25 Hillsbrad. Forever uses the retail 12.x API, so the real value may be 21: verify in game with C_Map.GetBestMapForUnit('player'). Other mapIds used here (Tirisfal 1420, Undercity 1458, Hillsbrad 1424) carry the same assumption.

Coordinates (0-100) come from wowforever.wclbox.com quest pages (Forever database); Sepulcher innkeeper/flight master cross-checked on games.gg. Wowhead Forever pages for quests 421, 445, 99 and 95981 confirm names, objectives and series, but expose no coordinates, min level or XP in the fetched text. The Forever-vs-Classic XP/level values come from foreverchanges.pro and wclbox, both labelled WoW Forever.
NPC ids: only Dalar Dawnweaver (1938) and Shadow Priest Allister (2121) were verified (Wowhead Forever). All other npcId fields are omitted on purpose, not found in any fetched source.

Forever-new quests in this file: 91920 Wild Eyes, 91921 Return to Quinn (Again), 98298 Arugal's Folly (5), 98299 Stop the Spread, 95981 Watching the Roads. Changed in Forever: 421 (min level 12), 430, 429, 450, 451, 452, 442. Level 20+ Forever-new quests not included: 95883 The Tortured Soul, 95884 The Offering Stone, 95885 The Offering of Blood (level 23, min 20). Also new: 1005 What Lurks Beyond and 1006 What Lies Beyond (elite, levels 20/18); no details found, probably Shadowfang Keep, not researched (wclbox 404).
Quest 442 Assault on Fenris Isle (level 24, elite, follows 448) not included; XP 1950.

Prereq gaps: 428 and 435 listed with no prerequisite; 445 (Delivery to Silverpine Forest) is the Tirisfal feeder but no source ties it to 428/421. 98298 prereq [99] is inferred from the Wowhead Forever series order. 95981 has no prerequisite on wclbox, while Wowhead lists it inside the 477..480 series order. 439 lists 443 as follow-up while 443 page lists 438 as prereq; both kept.

RESOLVED 2026-11-04, quest 421 Prove Your Worth: minLevel 12 and level 10 are CORRECT for Forever. wclbox quest 421 states min level 12, quest level 10, 850 XP, no prerequisites, and that Forever raised the minimum level from 9 to 12 (Classic: 9). Wowhead Forever shows neither min level nor XP, so wclbox is the only source. 422-424 keep minLevel 9 from wclbox (the series gate is quest 421 itself).

RESOLVED 2026-11-04, quest 445: XP 625 (wclbox) and objective text 'Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.' (identical on wclbox and Wowhead Forever); level 10, minLevel 9. wclbox says the quest is unchanged from Classic (Classic XP is 625). The earlier 630 value in tirisfal-glades.json came from forever-xp.com, which returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-04 and could not be re-checked; tirisfal-glades.json now carries the same values. Wowhead Forever lists no XP number for this quest.

objectiveCoords added 2026-11-04 (all from wclbox 'around x, y' text, mapId 1421, approximate area centre): 429 (57, 29) worg hunting area; 421 (52, 33) Moonrage Whitescalps trail near a mountain base; 447 (45, 38) bears and spiders; 423 (49, 32) Moonrage Gluttons and Fey Worgen, described as 'everywhere in the north and east'; 443 (67, 30) Rot Hide mobs.

STILL OPEN 91920 Wild Eyes: wclbox gives its collection area as 'around 65, 64 in Elwynn Forest', which is a different zone and is rejected, so no objectiveCoords were written. Murloc Eyes drop from Murloc Forager, Coastrunner, Tidehunter and Warrior (Silverpine coast near the Sepulcher? unverified).

STILL OPEN 437 The Dead Fields: no coordinates in any source; wclbox only says the Dead Fields farm is in the north of Silverpine Forest. No objectiveCoords written. Hadrec (43.4, 40.9) is the start and end.

STILL OPEN 91921 Return to Quinn (Again): wclbox and Wowhead Forever both list NO prerequisite and no follow-ups (Wowhead names it 'Back to Quinn (again)'; min level 10, level 11, Renferrel (42.8, 40.9) to Quinn Yorick (53.4, 12.6)). Real chain position unknown, prereqs left empty. In-game test needed: it probably only appears after 430 Return to Quinn or after 91920, but this is unverified.
Quest 460 Resting in Pieces: start is a ground item/area around 67, 30 (no NPC, no coordinates beyond approximate); 'start' omitted. Alaric's Head from Rot Hide mobs.
Missing XP: none missing after merging foreverchanges.pro values. 3221 XP 90 and 428 XP 230 per foreverchanges. 99 and 98298 and 98299 XP from foreverchanges/wclbox.

Spelling variants in sources: 'The Dead Field' vs 'The Dead Fields' (437), 'The Hidden Chamber' vs 'The Hidden Niche' (461), 'Deliah's Ring' vs 'The Engraved Ring' (440); Wowhead Forever is authoritative where known. Objective counts of 95981 and 98299 on wclbox are garbled.
Ruins of Lordaeron (new dungeon, 15-20, Undercity entrance). Dungeon quests, out of MVP scope. Sources disagree on quest IDs and none were verified. Counts differ (10 vs 15).
